cohort: 65 parturients with SS homozygous SCD and 130 non-sickle cell pregnant women
finding: Pregnant women with sickle cell disease had a higher risk of infection, cesarean delivery, prematurity, low birth weight, neonatal intensive care unit admission, and neonatal death compared to pregnant women without sickle cell disease.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in women with SCD compared to those without SCD.
gest_age: 35 weeks for SCD women and 38 weeks for non-SCD women
